title: mri_surf2surf
description: Resample one surface onto another using FreeSurfer

src_subject.description: Name of source subject as found in $SUBJECTS_DIR or ico for icosahedron.
src_subject.title: Source Subject

sval_path.description: Path of the file with input values.
sval_path.title: Source Value File

sval_xyz.description: Use xyz of a surface as input.
sval_xyz.title: Source Value XYZ Surface

projfrac.description: Use projected xyz of a surface as input.
projfrac.title: Project Frac

projabs.description: Use projected xyz absolute of a surface as input.
projabs.title: Project Absolute

sval_tal_xyz.description: Use tal xyz of a surface as input.
sval_tal_xyz.title: Source Value Tal XYZ Surface

sval_area.description: Use vertex area of a surface as input.
sval_area.title: Source Value Area Surface

sval_nxyz.description: Use surface normals of a surface as input.
sval_nxyz.title: Source Value NXyZ Surface

patch.description: Specify source patch file, target surface and number of dilations.
patch.title: Patch

reg_inv.description: Apply inverse registration file to sval-xyz.
reg_inv.title: Inverse Register

trg_subject.description: Name of target subject as found in $SUBJECTS_DIR or ico for icosahedron.
trg_subject.title: Target Subject

tval_path.description: Path of the file in which to store output values.
tval_path.title: Target Value File

tval_xyz.description: Save target value as a surface file with source xyz.
tval_xyz.title: Target Value XYZ Volume

trg_dist.description: Save distance from source to target vertices.
trg_dist.title: Target Distance File

s.description: Use the same subject for both source and target.
s.title: Single Subject

hemi.description: Hemisphere for both source and target (lh or rh).
hemi.title: Hemisphere

jac.description: Turn on jacobian correction, needed when applying to area or volume.
jac.title: Jacobian Correction Flag

surfreg.description: Surface registration for source and target (sphere.reg).
surfreg.title: Surface Registration

mapmethod.description: Method used to map from the vertices in one subject to another (nnfr or nnf).
mapmethod.title: Mapping Method

frame.description: Save only nth frame (when using paint output format).
frame.title: Frame Number

fwhm_src.description: Smooth the source to given FWHM.
fwhm_src.title: FWHM Source

fwhm_trg.description: Smooth the target to given FWHM.
fwhm_trg.title: FWHM Target

nsmooth_in.description: Number of smoothing iterations for input.
nsmooth_in.title: Input Smoothing Iterations

nsmooth_out.description: Number of smoothing iterations for output.
nsmooth_out.title: Output Smoothing Iterations

no_cortex.description: Do NOT use ?h.cortex.label as a smoothing mask (default).
no_cortex.title: No Cortex Flag

mul.description: Multiply the input by the given value.
mul.title: Multiply Input

div.description: Divide the input by the given value.
div.title: Divide Input

synth.description: Replace input with white Gaussian noise.
synth.title: Synthesize Input Flag

prune.description: Remove any voxel that is zero in any time point (for smoothing).
prune.title: Prune Zero Voxels Flag

proj_surf.description: Project vertices by mag*scale at each vertex.
proj_surf.title: Project Surface

proj_norm.description: Project vertices by distmm at each vertex.
proj_norm.title: Project Norm

rms.description: Save RMS of reg1-reg2 (primarily for testing).
rms.title: RMS File

rms_mask.description: Compute RMS in mask (primarily for testing).
rms_mask.title: RMS Mask File
